description:
Fetch one public catalogue asset by slug. Read-only. No sign-in and no API key.
A built-in kit/id returns the free editable downloads.source (.kcad.ts), studio_url, thumbnail_url, license, and published params and presets. params lists each declared control with its name, type, default, label, units, numeric range or choices. Dependent choicesBy maps constrain valid combinations. Download the source with plain GET and use its declared parameter names when editing.
Visual scene kits include usage.evaluate_script and usage.render_preview options to build or preview geometry without mechanism checks. This does not verify mechanical behavior. Manufacturing assets retain the default checks.
For community slugs, returns the search fields plus params (the knob schema), presets, rig, and public download paths.
Parameter values use each control's declared unit. Geometry stats.size_m and stats.origin_y are metres, Y up.
RIG: each rig entry is a named pivot. type "rotate" has range in degrees; type "slide" has range in metres; axis is the pivot's local x, y or z.
license is the SPDX id to keep with the asset. The download paths are public catalogue routes. Call get_asset_pack for a short-lived signed zip URL. Do not send an API key.
name: get_asset
title: Get Catalogue Asset
